pilot_001_population.source: thesis/results/intermediate/pilot_001/<model>/correctness.jsonl, run_id == pilot_001 (base run only; NOT the 1903 overview/repair/analysis rows)

candidate_subset.selection_rule: method-unchanged pilot_001 benchmarks (Wave-2B §34 categories A-E untouched) WHOSE GRADED COMPARISON PAYLOAD IS EXCLUSIVELY DISCRETE (int/bool/size_t scalars): for these, the verdict-relevant Wave-1/1b comparator classes K2/K3/K4/K5 are constructively unreachable (compile-time dead non-finite branches, no container in the graded path, no reachable BI condition) and K1/K7 are transport-only, so every historical verdict is method-stable by construction - no per-cell record analysis required.

excluded_from_prior_198_cell_proposal.reason: Floating-point graded payloads (vector<double>). K4: the pilot_001-era comparator was NaN-blind, so a historical 'pass' can hide non-finite candidate values without any trace in the frozen records; whether any given pass cell is affected is not determinable without re-measurement -> TRANSPORT_EFFECT_UNRESOLVED. Additionally for dense_la/00: K2 in-principle reachable (unpivoted pivot division in the oracle; NaN references structurally invisible historically). K3 (silent wrong-length pass under -DNDEBUG) shares the same no-trace problem for container payloads. Missing evidence is NOT interpreted as verdict-preserving.

transport_effect.population: the 198-cell cross-pilot proposal of the Wave-3 report (6 method-unchanged benchmarks x 11 models x 3 execution models x 1 sample)
transport_effect.counting_rule: Benchmark-level resolution: all 99 cells of the retained discrete-payload benchmarks are preserving by constructive unreachability; all 99 cells of the excluded FP-payload benchmarks are conservatively counted unresolved (individual fail-side cells there carry finite mismatch evidence and are plausibly preserving, but no per-cell claim is made). No cell shows evidence of a concrete verdict change (verdict_changed_cells = 0 means 'none demonstrated', not 'none possible' - for excluded cells the possibility is exactly why they are unresolved).
transport_effect.historical_stdout_reparse: NOT performed: historical pilot_001 stdout predates the nonce and MUST NOT be fed through the authenticated parser as a verdict comparison; the class analysis is code- and record-structure-based.

change_classes.name: authenticated nonce transport
change_classes.note: Verdict computation unchanged; only emission/authentication/parsing of the Validation/BI lines. Wave-1 tests document correct nonce emission by the trusted drivers (wave1_final_gate_report.md §3.3, §4, §12.1); Wave-1 §8.2 measured 0 effective self-declared markers across the complete pilot_001 stdout corpus, so no historical verdict depended on an unauthenticated line. Historical stdout was NOT re-parsed with the authenticated parser.

change_classes.name: non-finite reference -> BASELINE_INCOMPATIBLE
change_classes.note: Historically a NaN reference compared NaN-blind (silent pass); today the cell becomes baseline_incompatible and leaves the denominator. Historical NaN references are structurally invisible in the frozen records (Wave-1 §8.4). Reachability filter applied per benchmark: unreachable for discrete graded payloads; for dense_la/00 in-principle reachable (unpivoted division); for scan/30 and transform/55 oracle-side unreachable under the correctness-stage inputs.

change_classes.name: size-mismatch FAIL
change_classes.note: Historically assert() vanished under -DNDEBUG, allowing a silent wrong-length pass; today explicit SIZE_MISMATCH FAIL. Only applicable to container graded payloads (00/30/55); a silent historical wrong-length pass leaves no record trace, so its historical occurrence is not determinable. Not applicable to the retained scalar benchmarks.

change_classes.name: non-finite candidate FAIL
change_classes.note: Historically a NaN candidate value passed the NaN-blind tolerance predicate; today forced FAIL. A silent historical NaN pass leaves no record trace; effect on pass cells of FP benchmarks is not determinable from frozen records without re-measurement. Constructively unreachable for the retained benchmarks (int/bool/size_t scalar payloads; non-finite branches are compile-time dead code). Wave-1 §8.4 found 4 correctness records with non-finite got= values in pilot_001 (visible = already-failing cells).

change_classes.name: BASELINE_INCOMPATIBLE outranks process state
change_classes.note: Requires an authentic BI marker, which itself requires a reachable BI condition; pilot_001 predates the BI vocabulary entirely (0 markers in the frozen records). Unreachable for the retained benchmarks at the correctness stage (no BI path can fire: non-finite reference impossible for discrete payloads; search/35's TEST_SIZE==0 guard cannot fire at the correctness-stage size).

change_classes.name: repair terminal status stopped_baseline_incompatible
change_classes.note: Repair-state vocabulary change downstream of K2; outside the 396 iteration-0 cross-pilot population and measured to affect 0 pilot_001 records (0 BI stop_reasons; pilot_001 predates BI).

change_classes.name: legacy parser token-robustness fix (driver_wrapper.py)
change_classes.note: Upstream legacy parser reads the first token after the colon; identical result for all intended legacy-mode driver output (verified by real upstream regression, Wave-1 §12.3).

non_finite_reachable_by_benchmark.dense_la/00_dense_la_lu_decomp: true (oracle: unguarded pivot division, baseline.hpp:16; candidate: vector<double> payload)
non_finite_reachable_by_benchmark.graph/15_graph_edge_count: false (scalar int payload; non-finite branches compile-time dead)
non_finite_reachable_by_benchmark.scan/30_scan_prefix_sum: true (candidate: vector<double> payload; oracle-side unreachable under correctness-stage inputs)
non_finite_reachable_by_benchmark.transform/55_transform_relu: true (candidate: vector<double> payload; oracle performs no arithmetic, cannot create non-finite from finite input)

statistical_caveats: exactly 1 sample per cell - no within-cell variance estimation is possible
only 12 of 60 benchmarks were in pilot_001; only 3 of those 12 remain quantitatively comparable
the retained subset consists exclusively of scalar discrete-output benchmarks - a structural selection toward the simplest output class; results on it do not generalize to the suite
double selection bias: stratified 12-benchmark pilot selection, then method-stability filtering
PILOT_002_REUSES_PILOT_001_GENERATIONS = UNDECIDED - attribution sharpness (generation vs grading) depends on that open decision
the classification asserts FORMAL admissibility of a quantitative comparison on the named 99 cells only; it does NOT assert that pilot_001 is a strong, precise or statistically robust baseline
rationale: The Wave-3 report's 198-cell quantitative subset claim treated the suite-wide Wave-1/1b transport/comparator delta (F = WAVE1_TRANSPORT_CHANGE, kept separate from the benchmark-level A/B/C/D/E categories) as a caveat. This gate re-examined F class by class against the actual frozen records: K1/K7 are transport-only (with Wave-1 measured evidence that no pilot_001 verdict depended on unauthenticated markers); K2/K3/K4/K5 are verdict-relevant but constructively unreachable for discrete graded payloads. For the three FP-payload benchmarks the NaN-blind history makes hidden verdict changes undetectable in frozen records, so their 99 cells cannot be certified method-stable without re-measurement and are excluded. The quantitative claim is therefore narrowed to the 99 discrete-payload cells; A∪B∪C∪D∪E = 34/60 remains a benchmark-level change set only and F is never folded into it.
